tierMeaning.basic-table: Table elements or display:table* with at most border-spacing, colspan/rowspan and col/colgroup; nothing in the blocking list
tierMeaning.table-plus: As basic-table, but also border-collapse, caption, table-layout:fixed, percentages, vertical-align, box-sizing, overflow, outline/box-shadow or Ahem text
tierMeaning.blocked: Uses a feature far from table layout (see BLOCKING)
tierMeaning.no-table: No table element and no display:table* found in test or reference
tierMeaning.missing-reference: A reference file is not in the vendored tree
